answer: Resist sybil swarms with sponsored entry. A new key must collect independent vouches from established, slashable sponsors outside a shared funding graph; each may endorse only a few applicants per epoch, with stake frozen for a glacier-length challenge window. Peers seal a unique work-puzzle solution as a quartz hash bound to the applicant's key and one nonce. After hash and vouches survive disputes, the ledger issues a non-transferable jade pass unlocking voting weight in delayed tranches. Shared wallets and copied wording fail those checks, so a farm burns fresh frozen stake per replica.
